definition.en: Disinvestment refers to the sale or liquidation of assets or subsidiaries by the government, specifically involving the reduction of government equity in Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs).
definition.hi: Disinvestment refers to the sale or liquidation of assets or subsidiaries by the government, specifically involving the reduction of government equity in Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs).

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is critical for GS-3 as it relates to fiscal policy, resource mobilization, and the restructuring of the Indian economy. Understanding the shift from state-led industrialization to market-oriented reforms is essential for both Prelims and Mains.
